title: My home
summary: Name the rooms of a flat and say what there is in it, with the place first: فِي الشَّقَّة شُرْفَة.
intro: Daniel has found a small flat in Cairo. Today you name the rooms, such as غُرْفَة (room), مَطْبَخ (kitchen) and حَمَّام (bathroom), and learn how Arabic says 'there is': you simply start with the place. فِي الشَّقَّة شُرْفَة means 'there is a balcony in the flat'. No extra word is needed.
objectives: Name seven parts of a flat or house
Say what there is in a place with فِي + place + thing
Describe rooms as big, small, new or clean
Ask how much the rent is with كَمِ الْإِيجَار؟

realLife.title: Daniel's new flat
realLife.story: After a month in the student residence, Daniel rents a small flat not far from the school. On Saturday Sami and Layla come to see it. It has one bedroom, a tiny kitchen and, best of all, a balcony with a view of the Nile.

sentences.en: There is a bedroom and a kitchen in the flat.
sentences.literal: in the flat (is) a room (of) sleep and a kitchen

mistakes.why: For 'there is', the thing has no الـ. With الـ you say الْمَطْبَخ فِي الشَّقَّة (the kitchen is in the flat).

sentences.en: Is there a balcony in the flat?
The bedroom is big and the bathroom is small.
sentences.literal: the room (of) the sleep (is) big and the bathroom (is) small

mistakes.why: غُرْفَة is feminine (it ends in ة), so the adjective takes ة too.

sentences.en: There is a big window in the living room.
sentences.literal: in the room (of) the sitting (is) a window big

dialogue.title: Welcome to my flat!
dialogue.culture: When a friend moves into a new home, say مَبْرُوك (congratulations). The usual reply is اللّٰه يُبَارِكُ فِيكَ (may God bless you). Egyptians also love to visit a new home with a small gift, such as sweets or a plant.

lines.ar: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! تَفَضَّلَا، هٰذِهِ شَقَّتِي الْجَدِيدَة. هِيَ صَغِيرَة، لٰكِنَّهَا جَمِيلَة.
lines.en: Welcome! Come in, both of you. This is my new flat. It is small, but it is lovely.

lines.ar: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰه يَا دَانْيَال! الشَّقَّة نَظِيفَة وَجَدِيدَة. كَمْ غُرْفَةً فِيهَا؟
lines.en: How lovely, Daniel! The flat is clean and new. How many rooms does it have?

lines.ar: فِيهَا غُرْفَةُ نَوْم وَاحِدَة، وَغُرْفَةُ جُلُوس صَغِيرَة، وَمَطْبَخ وَحَمَّام.
lines.en: There is one bedroom, a small living room, a kitchen and a bathroom.

lines.ar: وَأَيْنَ الْمَطْبَخ؟ أَنَا أُحِبُّ الطَّبْخ كَثِيرًا، تَعْرِفُ ذٰلِكَ!
lines.en: And where is the kitchen? I really love cooking, as you know!

lines.ar: الْمَطْبَخ هُنَا، عَلَى الْيَسَار. هُوَ صَغِير جِدًّا، لِشَخْص وَاحِد فَقَطْ.
lines.en: The kitchen is here, on the left. It is very small, just for one person.

lines.ar: صَحِيح، الْمَطْبَخ صَغِير، لٰكِنْ فِيهِ نَافِذَة كَبِيرَة. هٰذَا جَمِيل!
lines.en: True, the kitchen is small, but it has a big window. That is nice!

lines.ar: وَهَلْ فِي الشَّقَّة شُرْفَة؟ الشُّرْفَة مُهِمَّة جِدًّا فِي الصَّيْف فِي الْقَاهِرَة!
lines.en: And is there a balcony in the flat? A balcony is very important in summer in Cairo!

lines.ar: نَعَم! تَعَالَيَا، الشُّرْفَة فِي غُرْفَةِ الْجُلُوس. اُنْظُرَا، هٰذَا هُوَ النِّيل!
lines.en: Yes! Come with me, the balcony is in the living room. Look, that is the Nile!

lines.ar: يَا سَلَام! الْمَنْظَر رَائِع. أَنْتَ مَحْظُوظ جِدًّا يَا دَانْيَال.
lines.en: Wow! The view is wonderful. You are very lucky, Daniel.

lines.ar: وَغُرْفَةُ النَّوْم؟ هَلْ هِيَ كَبِيرَة، أَمْ صَغِيرَة مِثْلَ الْمَطْبَخ؟
lines.en: And what about the bedroom? Is it big, or small like the kitchen?

lines.ar: غُرْفَةُ النَّوْم كَبِيرَة، وَفِيهَا نَافِذَة عَلَى الشَّارِع. وَالْحَمَّام صَغِير جِدًّا!
lines.en: The bedroom is big, and it has a window onto the street. And the bathroom is very small!

lines.ar: وَكَمِ الْإِيجَار؟ الشُّقَق فِي هٰذَا الْحَيّ غَالِيَة قَلِيلًا.
lines.en: And how much is the rent? Flats in this neighbourhood are a little expensive.

lines.ar: الْإِيجَار سَبْعَةُ آلَافِ جُنَيْه فِي الشَّهْر، وَالشَّقَّة قَرِيبَة مِنَ الْمَدْرَسَة.
lines.en: The rent is seven thousand pounds a month, and the flat is close to the school.

lines.ar: مُمْتَاز! شَقَّة جَمِيلَة وَقَرِيبَة. مَبْرُوك عَلَى الْبَيْت الْجَدِيد يَا صَدِيقِي!
lines.en: Excellent! A lovely flat, and close by. Congratulations on your new home, my friend!

lines.ar: اللّٰه يُبَارِكُ فِيكَ! وَالْآن، مَنْ يُرِيدُ شَايًا عَلَى الشُّرْفَة؟
lines.en: God bless you! And now, who would like some tea on the balcony?

reading.title: Daniel's flat
reading.ar: شَقَّةُ دَانْيَال صَغِيرَة وَجَمِيلَة. فِي الشَّقَّة غُرْفَةُ نَوْم وَغُرْفَةُ جُلُوس وَمَطْبَخ وَحَمَّام. فِي غُرْفَةِ الْجُلُوس شُرْفَة، وَمِنَ الشُّرْفَة مَنْظَر جَمِيل عَلَى النِّيل.
reading.en: Daniel's flat is small and lovely. In the flat there is a bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. There is a balcony off the living room, and from the balcony there is a beautiful view of the Nile.

quiz.prompt: How do you say 'There is a balcony in the flat'?
Choose the correct sentence: 'The bedroom is big.'
Which syllable is stressed in this word?
What can Daniel see from his balcony?

completion: Well done! You can show a friend around a flat and say what there is in it.
